products.title: Modern Heritage Evansley 3-Seater Fabric Sofa with 2 Pillows

description.plain:
Relaxation meets refined design with the Evansley 3-Seater Sofa, perfect for those who appreciate casual, contemporary style. Its sleek, neutral color palette allows it to seamlessly blend into various home settings while offering plenty of seating for everyday lounging. The generously sized cushions and supportive bolster pillows ensure maximum comfort, making it an inviting spot for relaxation. Plus, the reversible seat and back cushions enhance its durability, allowing you to switch up the look and feel when needed. 

Engineered for modern living, the Evansley Sofa features easy-to-maintain Next-Gen Nuvella™ fabric, designed to withstand daily wear and tear. The machine-washable covers and stain-resistant upholstery keep it looking fresh with minimal effort. Supported by a sag-resistant platform foundation, this sofa delivers long-lasting comfort without the worry of sagging or uneven support. Available in Pewter and Navy, this sofa offers style, comfort, and convenience all in one.

products.title: Modern Heritage Darcy 3-Seater Fabric Sofa with Pillow Arms

description.plain:
[Description]

Talk about fine lines and great curves. That’s the beauty of this standout sofa—made to suit your appreciation for clean, contemporary style. A striking flared frame, comfy pillow top armrests, and ultra-soft upholstery that holds up to everyday living complete this fashion statement.

Pillow Arms

Pillow arm sofas make lying down in the living room even more comfortable. Featuring oversized cushions draped over the armrests, these arms are typically seen on plush furniture. Opt for an overstuffed pillow arm sofa if you prefer a soft feel.

Pillow Back

Pillow back sofas, also known as scatter back sofas, are characterized by their loose assortment of large pillows arranged across the backrest. These pillows are usually upholstered in the same color as the rest of the sofa. Typically, this type of couch does not have any traditional fitted back cushions. It does, however, provide a plush feel when kicking back and relaxing.

Fabric Upholstery

Soft and cozy! Fabric upholstery is an economical, environmentally friendly way to show off your eye for style and color. It allows for a multitude of patterns or color options.

Frame Construction

Corner-blocked frame for strength. Frame constructions have been rigorously tested to simulate the home and transportation environments for improved durability. Components are secured with combinations of glue, blocks, interlocking panels and staples. Seats and back spring rails are cut from mixed hardwood and engineered lumber.
